item.title: She Was Found Inside A Suitcase
item.description: Eight-year-old Sandra Cantu vanished while playing near her California home, triggering a desperate search. Days later, her body was discovered inside a suitcase, leading investigators to uncover a shocking suspect and one of the most heartbreaking child murder cases in recent history.

item.title: The Dungeons & Dragons Murder That Shocked Everyone
item.description: In 2008, John Eichinger murdered three members of a Pennsylvania family after becoming obsessed with one of the victims. The brutal killings and his fixation on fantasy role-playing games drew national attention, but investigators found the motive was rooted in obsession, rejection, and escalating violence—not the game itself.

item.title: She Exposed Jeffrey Epstein's Powerful Network
item.description: Virginia Giuffre became one of the most prominent survivors to publicly accuse Jeffrey Epstein and his associates of sexual abuse. Her memoir recounts her fight to expose a network of powerful figures, helping bring global attention to one of the most significant sex trafficking scandals in recent history.

item.title: What Really Happened To JonBenét Ramsey?
item.description: Six-year-old JonBenét Ramsey was found dead inside her family's Colorado home the morning after Christmas in 1996. A bizarre ransom note, conflicting evidence, and decades of unanswered questions turned the case into one of the most infamous unsolved mysteries in American history.
